This is exactly the OTHER way around. Most usages of SQLite are as an application file format. Firefox stores bookmarks, history, cookies in SQLite files in the profiles folder. Messaging apps (WhatsApp, Signal, etc. use SQLite for chat history). macOS and Windows use SQLite in various subsystems, ex: Spotlight metadata, application cache. Mobile apps use SQLite heavily. And probably ten thousand other cases as a file format if I bother to look up more.

> “I see no downside in using sqlite as an application file format.”  
> —— `psnehanshu`  
> 评论链接：[https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46079942](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46079942)

> “Most application's file formats are structured as a tree, not as flat tables. If your application's data is flat tables or name-value pairs then SQLite is an obvious choice. But if it is tree structured then it is less obvious.”

> 评论链接：[https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46080273](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46080273)

- 原始文章：[https://www.sqlite.org/affcase1.html](https://www.sqlite.org/affcase1.html)
- 发布者：`whatisabcdefgh`
- 时间：2025-09-04

这篇讨论的是 OpenDocument 是否可以使用 SQLite，但评论大量延伸到 SQLite 作为应用程序文件格式、文档格式和交换格式的优缺点。

评论原句：

> “This is exactly the OTHER way around. Most usages of SQLite are as an application file format. Firefox stores bookmarks, history, cookies in SQLite files in the profiles folder. > —— `lenkite`  
> 评论链接：[https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45147835](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45147835)

> “If you're going to use SQLite as an application file format, you should:  
> 1. Enable the secure_delete pragma ...  
> 2. Enable the options described at ... under ‘Untrusted SQLite Database Files’ ...”  
> —— `agwa`  
> 评论链接：[https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45134010](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45134010)

另一个评论区分了本地应用文件与文档交换格式：

> “As a document _exchange_/_interchange_ format, what I prefer for durability is a non-binary format (e.g. XML based). For local use, I agree SQLite might be much faster than ZIP, and of course the ability to query based on SQL has its own flexibility merits.”  
> —— `jll29`  
> 评论链接：[https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45134255](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45134255)

如果只看一篇，优先看第一篇 **SQLite as an Application File Format**；第二篇更适合补充 OpenDocument、文档交换格式和安全方面的争论。
